name: Classic Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with a sweet-savory tamarind sauce, tender chicken, scrambled egg, fresh bean sprouts, and roasted peanuts.
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Whisk tamarind paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar together in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat, cook chicken until golden.
Push chicken to the side, crack in eggs and scramble gently.
Add noodles and sauce mixture; toss rapidly for 2-3 minutes until sauce is absorbed.
Stir in bean sprouts, serve immediately topped with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: Beef Tacos al Pastor
description: Flavorful seasoned flank steak served in warm corn tortillas with diced pineapple, chopped onions, and fresh cilantro.
instructions: Season sliced steak generously with taco seasoning.
Sear steak in a scorching hot skillet for 3-4 minutes until nicely browned.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet until soft and pliable.
Assemble tacos with beef, a spoon of diced pineapple, raw onion, and cilantro.
Serve hot with salsa verde on the side.

name: Creamy Tuscan Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets simmered in a velvety garlic, sun-dried tomato, and spinach cream sauce over penne.
instructions: Boil penne pasta in salted water according to package directions.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper; sear in a skillet for 4 mins per side until cooked through, then remove.
In the same skillet, sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Reduce heat, pour in heavy cream, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in spinach and parmesan until spinach wilts and sauce thickens.
Toss in cooked pasta and place salmon fillets back on top.

name: Teriyaki Tofu Rice Bowl
description: Crispy pan-fried tofu glazed in home-made teriyaki sauce, served over fluffy jasmine rice with steamed broccoli.
instructions: Toss cubed tofu in cornstarch until lightly coated.
Pan-fry tofu in vegetable oil over medium-high heat until golden crisp on all sides (approx. 8-10 mins).
Whisk soy sauce, honey, mirin, and 1 tbsp water together.
Pour teriyaki sauce over the crispy tofu; simmer for 2 minutes until glossy and thick.
Serve tofu over warm jasmine rice with broccoli, garnished with sesame seeds.

name: Classic Cheeseburger
description: Juicy seared beef patty topped with melted cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and special sauce on a toasted brioche bun.
instructions: Divide ground beef into two loose balls, then smash flat into thin patties.
Season aggressively with salt and black pepper.
Sear in a hot cast-iron skillet for 2.5 minutes until a deep crust forms.
Flip patties, immediately top with cheddar, and cook for 1 more minute.
Toast brioche buns, spread burger sauce, and assemble with lettuce, tomato, and pickles.

name: Hearty Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting classic soup brimming with shredded chicken, egg noodles, carrots, celery, and fresh herbs in a rich broth.
instructions: Melt butter in a large soup pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook for 6 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken stock and bring to a boil.
Add egg noodles and simmer uncovered for 8-10 minutes until tender.
Stir in shredded chicken and fresh parsley; heat through for 2 minutes.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, serve warm.

name: Greek Lemon Orzo Soup (Avgolemono)
description: Silky, velvety Greek soup combining tender shredded chicken, orzo pasta, and a bright lemon-egg broth.
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot. Add orzo and cook for 9 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk eggs and fresh lemon juice together thoroughly.
Slowly ladle 1 cup of hot broth into the egg mixture while whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Reduce pot heat to low, slowly pour tempered egg mixture back into the pot while stirring continuously.
Add shredded chicken and simmer gently for 3 minutes until thick and creamy (do not boil).
Garnish with fresh dill.

name: Pork Carnitas Burrito Bowl
description: Crispy slow-cooked shredded pork served over cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn salsa, and fresh avocado.
instructions: Crisp up cooked pork carnitas in a hot skillet for 5 minutes.
Base each bowl with cilantro-lime rice.
Top with equal portions of carnitas, black beans, corn, and avocado slices.
Finish with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkled Cotija cheese.

name: Spicy Seafood Kimchi Ramen
description: A fiery, flavorful soup packed with ramen noodles, mixed seafood, aged kimchi, soft-boiled egg, and scallions.
instructions: Bring broth to a simmer with chopped kimchi and gochujang paste.
Add ramen noodles and seafood mix to the boiling broth.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until noodles are chewy and seafood is cooked through.
Transfer to a bowl, top with a soft-boiled egg half and sliced green onions.

name: Vegetarian Falafel Pita Wrap
description: Crispy chickpeas falafel balls tucked in warm pita pockets with diced cucumber, tomatoes, and creamy tahini sauce.
instructions: Warm pita bread and cut open top to create pockets.
Stuff pita pockets with fresh lettuce, cucumber, tomato, and falafel balls.
Drizzle generously with creamy tahini sauce and top with pickled red onions.

name: Pork Tonkatsu Curry
description: Crispy panko-breaded pork cutlet served alongside rich, savory Japanese curry sauce and warm steamed rice.
instructions: Boil cubed potatoes and carrots until tender; dissolve curry roux blocks in 2 cups hot water and combine with veggies.
Dredge pork chops in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat thoroughly with panko breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry cutlets in oil at 350°F (175°C) for 5-6 minutes until golden and crispy.
Slice cutlet into strips and arrange over rice, ladling warm curry sauce alongside.

name: Creamy Tomato & Basil Pasta
description: Rich tomato sauce folded with heavy cream, fresh basil, and garlic, tossed with al dente rigatoni pasta.
instructions: Cook rigatoni in salted boiling water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Sauté minced garlic in olive oil for 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and fresh basil leaves until smooth.
Toss pasta into sauce with a splash of pasta water, finish with grated Parmesan.

name: Grilled Fish Tacos with Slaw
description: Flaky seasoned white fish served in warm tortillas topped with crunchy lime-cilantro cabbage slaw and Chipotle crema.
instructions: Season fish with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Pan-sear fish in skillet for 3-4 minutes per side until flaky.
Toss cabbage slaw with lime juice and fresh cilantro.
Flake fish into warm tortillas, top with slaw, and drizzle with chipotle mayo.
